messages:
Maya: Quick sync — landing copy for the launch. We need three concise lanes: dev-first (fast time-to-value), infra/platform (predictable throughput & cost), and compliance/security (private deployments). Also: one webinar hook, three short benchmark blurbs for social, and a simple inbound lead routing map for ops.

AJ: Cool. Two headline directions to test: "Ship LLM features in hours" (playful, product-led) vs "Inference you can rely on at scale" (trust). Which do we want on the homepage hero variants?

Noah: I vote first headline for the Hosted/dev lane. For infra: "Predictable throughput, predictable cost". For private/compliance: "Private deployments. Audit-ready controls. Customer key management." Keep them trimmed.

Lina: Webinar idea: 30-min format, demo + benchmark + migration checklist. Title draft: "From prototype to production: cost and latency playbook for LLM inference". CTA: "Register — limited seats"

Maya: Nice. Can we get three social launch posts (X/LinkedIn) that map to lanes? Short copy only, include CTA + registration URL placeholder.

Noah: Drafts: 
- Hosted/dev post: "Build with LLMs, not infrastructure. Get from prompt to prod in hours with Redwood Inference. Register: <link> #llmdev #launch"
- Dedicated/infra post: "Predictable throughput, predictable costs. Reserve GPU capacity tuned for production workloads. RSVP: <link> #inference #sre"
- Private/compliance post: "Bring inference into your VPC — KMS, audit logs, on‑prem options. Secure your deployment: <link> #security #privacy"

AJ: Solid. Lina — routing rules for webinar leads? I suggest immediate qualification flow: company_size>500 or security_tag => AE; else SDR; if legal/compliance interest => Enterprise AE and CS handoff.

Lina: Can express that as a tiny YAML snippet for Ops. Putting it here so engineers/ops can copy: 
```yaml
source: webinar_signup
utm_campaign: q2_launch
rules:
  - if: company_size >= 500
    route: AE Enterprise
  - if: contains(tags, 'security') or contains(tags, 'compliance')
    route: AE Enterprise
  - if: intent_score >= 7
    route: AE SDR-Priority
  - else:
    route: SDR
send_notifications: [sales, marketing_ops]
```

Noah: That snippet looks usable. For the landing copy, small benchmark blurbs (one-liners) we can put next to logos or on the homepage cards: 
- "Bench: 30% lower p95 latency at 2k tokens vs baseline model X"
- "Throughput: 2x effective throughput on shared GPU pools with smart batching"
- "Cost: typical unit-cost reduction up to 40% after prefix/KV caching"
(keep as claimy-but-guarded; legal to review)

Maya: Good — legal review flagged but ok to present as "internal benchmark" for now. Noah, can you draft hero/subhead variants for each lane? Keep them <12 words.

Noah: Drafts: 
- Hosted (dev): "Ship LLM features in hours. SDKs, streaming, and low-lift onboarding."
- Dedicated (infra): "Reserved GPU capacity with predictable SLOs and burst options."
- Private (security): "Private control plane, customer KMS, audit trails for regulated workloads."

Lina: I'll set UTMs: utm_source=organic, utm_medium=social, utm_campaign=q2_launch. Webinar reg page to populate lead source.

AJ: Action items: 
- Noah: finalize copy + social drafts and deliver to Maya (EOD Tue).
- AJ: build webinar landing page + register event in calendar, wire up tracking to SFDC campaign Q2-Launch.
- Lina: implement routing YAML in Marketo/Hub and confirm notifications to sales ops.

Maya: Agree. Also add a tiny FAQ on the landing page about model compatibility, quantization options, and support tiers — 3 bullets each.

Noah: Will add bullets. Example: 
- Model compat: Open-weight models + curated catalog.
- Quantization: Preset profiles for latency vs cost.
- Support: 24/7 on Dedicated, enterprise SLAs for Private.

calendar-bot: Meeting scheduled: Launch copy review — Tue 09:30 PT (30m) — attendees: Maya, AJ, Noah, Lina

AJ: :thumbsup:

Lina: on it — I'll confirm routing tests after deploy.

Maya: Thanks team — feel good about direction. Noah, ping when drafts are in.

Noah: Pinged — uploads incoming in #assets.

Maya: Closing thread, will follow up in the meeting. :tada:
